name: Taaga Flared Maroon Cotton Long Dress
description: Contemporary flared long dress from Aarong's Taaga sub-brand crafted from 100% breathable cotton in rich maroon with grey, golden, and coral screen-printed motifs. Features a stylish square neckline, 3-quarter sleeves, and an airy relaxed silhouette tailored for comfort in tropical heat and casual social gatherings.
